02 / Design expertise

Graphic design first.
Production-aware thinking.

My primary focus is professional graphic design and brand identity. AI visual creation adds another capability, supported by hands-on knowledge of print production.

01 / Graphic & Brand Design

Build a consistent visual identity.

From a logo system to the everyday materials a brand needs.

  • Brand identity and visual systems
  • Arabic/English layouts and commercial graphics
  • Social media, print and environmental applications
Core tools: Adobe Illustrator · Photoshop · InDesign
02 / AI Visual & Video Creation

Make an idea easy to see.

Combine concept development, visual direction and AI generation.

  • AI-generated images and product concepts
  • AI film and visual storytelling
  • Refinement for visual consistency across scenes
Creative workflow: Higgsfield · Freepik Spaces · AI assistants

Backed by production experience.

Print-ready artwork, large-format graphics, DTF / UV DTF, signage and clean SVG / AI cut files. Hands-on familiarity with Roland, Sky Color and SignMaster workflows.

Additional tools: CorelDRAW · MainTop · SAi Flexi / PhotoPRINT · AutoCAD · RDWorks basics
03 / About MD Shimul

Creative direction.
Practical follow-through.

I’m a Bangladeshi designer based in Riyadh. Since 2022, my graphic design work has developed alongside hands-on production experience. Today, I combine brand design with generative AI to create commercial visuals, concepts and films.

Get my one-page profile ↓

Brand thinking across formats

Identity systems that carry through documents, physical spaces and digital layouts.

AI with a communication goal

For AFWAJ, I developed a sleeping-pod concept and a film explaining how it would be used during Hajj. For NOOR X1, I used locked references, first/last frames and iterative QC to direct a consistent automotive commercial.

Attention to the final file

Practical knowledge of sizing, materials, prepress and vector preparation informs design decisions.
